card.name: Partway through Fruit and Dose headings
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the first part of a word or heading in structured text, such as the "F" of "Fruit" in plant description fields or "Dos" in a dosing table header. It also fires weakly on linking words like "known for" and "found" in place descriptions.

modes.label: Linking words in descriptions
modes.description: Short words in descriptions of places or plants, like for, found and from.
modes.example: it is known<< for>> the Lipica Stud Farm.
